summary.text: Charles Delaney is an unenrolled candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives 4th Suffolk District in the November 3, 2026 general election against incumbent Democrat David Biele.

paragraphs.text: Charles Delaney ran for Boston City Council District 2 in 2025, advancing from the September 9, 2025 nonpartisan primary alongside incumbent Edward Flynn.
Flynn won the November 4, 2025 general election with 86.6 percent of the vote to Delaney's 12.1 percent.
